source: Mineral Resources Map of Nigeria 2023 (NGSA) PDF; printed graticule of the map frame. The PDF's /VP /Measure geographic transform and any declared CRS were not used.
method: Least-squares fit of the printed 2-degree graticule in the parsed vector content stream (6 meridians at x = 341.44 ... 1917.43 pt, 5 parallels at y_up = 375.66 ... 1636.47 pt, 315.20 pt per 2 degrees).

model.note: x_pt is PDF user space (y up); y_up_pt = 2160 - y_pt for a top-down page coordinate.

validation.graticule_fit: exact by construction (map frame corners map to 2.30/14.85 E, 3.83/14.05 N)

town_squares_vs_geonames.note: 478 black 1.6 pt town squares compared with GeoNames; matches are approximate because several towns share names.

unbiased_subset.note: No systematic offset detectable in the best-matching subset.

boundary_check.method: Printed international boundary (OC7, 4 paths) vs Natural Earth admin-0
boundary_check.note: The two datasets generalise differently; the residual is a source-geometry difference, not a georeferencing error.

reference_polygon: shapefiles/nigeria_admin0/ (used for the in_nga indicator only)
limitations: The mineral symbols are rasterised at 96 dpi; the printed code letters inside them are 4-6 px high.
Depth of the source raster: about 0.68 km per pixel.
Symbol positions carry the georeferencing error above plus about +/-0.7 km of raster resolution.
